[[MOC's, TOC's & Indizes]]

# Structuring of information

TO structure information in a way that allows to link everything together, we use the concepts of Map of Content (MOC) and Table of Content (TOC). Additionally we can use tags and links to allow searching for certain topics more efficient and also allows jumpong around the documentation like a kangaroo 🦘

## Blueprint for new pages

To allow faster and easier setup of new pages, use the following template:

```markdown
# Page Title

tags: #your #tags

# Page Title

links: [[themes/000 Index|Index]]

---

* [[000 Index|Link to Index]]
* [[006 MOCs TOCs Indizes|Link to this page]]

---
links: [[themes/000 Index|Index]]
```
